question.text: Section 115UB sub-section (2) treatment of losses for Cat I/II AIFs:

answer.text: Losses pass through to unit holders freely
Business losses NOT passed to unit holders (carried forward by fund); 'other' losses not passed if units held < 12 months

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.1 (Treatment of Losses), business losses of Investment Fund are NOT passed through; non-business losses are passed-through only if units held >= 12 months. **The Trap:** Blanket pass-through/ignore is incorrect. **Cross-Exam Context:** Finance Act 2019 amendment. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Document holding periods carefully to maximize loss pass-through benefit.
